accepted:
Use case: product-mockup. Isolated material source for a high fidelity 2D frame animation of a historical manuscript binding tie.
One single straight, slim, horizontally laid medieval-style tightly braided SILK CORD, full length visible, centered across a wide landscape transparent canvas. Diameter is approximately one tenth of the image height. No knots, no loops, no text or accessories. This is a fine formal manuscript tie, NOT coarse hemp, nautical rope, jute or thick cable. Dark faded oxblood / russet-wine silk, softly muted and aged, finely interlaced smooth fibers visible in a subtle narrow diagonal braid. Three-dimensional round-to-slightly-flattened silk cord with a softly luminous worn surface, not shiny satin ribbon or synthetic plastic. Very small isolated worn fiber hairs, mild unevenness and handling wear, no mold or gross damage. Both ends neatly worn and softly frayed without giant tassels. Perfectly straight centerline and uniform width for material mapping; no perspective taper, no floor, no cast shadow. Soft diffuse upper-left lighting. Macro photographic material detail, impeccable sharpness and tactile authenticity. Exactly one entire cord, no second row, natural edge alpha on truly transparent background.
rejected:
Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: isolated material source for high-resolution 2D frame-by-frame animation.
Create one single completely straight horizontally stretched length of old natural flax/hemp binding cord on a fully transparent background. Whole cord entirely visible with generous margin at each end. Landscape composition. The cord extends nearly the full image width, centered at mid-height, with diameter approximately 1/13 of the image height. It is fine three-ply hand-twisted flax twine for binding a medieval parchment roll, NOT heavy ship rope. Warm dark honey / muted ochre brown fiber, dry matte surface, subtle uneven diameter, deeply readable spiral fiber bundles, fine pale frayed hair fibers, authentic worn softened surface. No mold, rot, stains, metal, decorative ribbon, wax, knots, loops, scroll, hands, background, floor, text or extra objects.
Slight natural asymmetric wear but perfectly straight centerline, square-on view with no perspective taper, consistent diameter end to end. Left and right ends just naturally trimmed, not large fluffy tassels. Soft diffuse upper-left studio illumination, realistic tactile volume but no cast floor shadow and no bright specular highlights. Extremely sharp detailed photoreal macro material, not illustration or a smooth CG tube. Exactly one cord only, no coil, no duplicate rows. This source will be mapped continuously along changing 2D paths; clear side-lit twisted fibers are essential.
note: Coarse hemp was stopped after the user's material question; only silk is used in the specimen.
